# Stories From School

> > A blog tracking Washington State education policy and legislation, connecting classroom practice with legislative developments.

Stories From School provides regular updates on Washington State's 2026 legislative session, focusing on education funding, policy bills, and their impact on schools. The site features insights from educator contributors who bridge the gap between classroom realities and state policy decisions.

## Key Topics

- Washington State Legislature
- Education Policy
- SB 6346
- Education Funding
- 2026 Legislative Session
- Budget Cuts
- School Funding
- Early Learning
- Special Education
- Chris Reykdal
- House Education Committee
- Legislative Updates
- Homeschooling Regulation
- Running Start Programs
- Student Mental Health

## Legislative Updates

- [Legislative Update: Friday, March 13, 2026](https://storiesfromschool.org/legislative-update-friday-march-13-2026): Update on WA 2026 legislative session, SB 6346, and education funding.
- [Legislative Update: Friday, March 6, 2026](https://storiesfromschool.org/legislative-update-friday-march-6-2026): WA legislature update on SB 6346, committee actions, and education policy.
- [Legislative Update: Friday, February 27, 2026](https://storiesfromschool.org/legislative-update-friday-february-27-2026): Update on WA budget proposal and education funding from Chris Reykdal.
- [Legislative Update: Friday, February 20, 2026](https://storiesfromschool.org/legislative-update-friday-february-20-2026): WA education bill tracking including SHB 2360, ESHB 2534, ESHB 1795.
- [Legislative Update: Friday, February 13, 2026](https://storiesfromschool.org/legislative-update-friday-february-13-2026): WA legislature update on bill cutoffs and education policy deadlines.
- [Legislative Update: Friday, February 6, 2026](https://storiesfromschool.org/legislative-update-friday-february-6-2026): WA education policy update on SB 6261, homeschooling, and budget cuts.
- [Legislative Update: Friday, January 30, 2026](https://storiesfromschool.org/legislative-update-friday-january-30-2026): WA legislature update on homeschool regulation and Running Start programs.
- [Legislative Update: Friday, January 23, 2026](https://storiesfromschool.org/legislative-update-friday-january-23-2026): WA education committee updates on budget cuts and special education policy.
- [Legislative Update: Friday, January 16, 2026](https://storiesfromschool.org/legislative-update-friday-january-16-2026): WA 2026 session update on student mental health and budget shortfall.
- [Pre-Session Update: January 9, 2026](https://storiesfromschool.org/pre-session-update-january-9-2026): Preview of 2026 WA legislative session and education funding outlook.

## Core Pages

- [Stories From School | Practice Meets Policy](https://storiesfromschool.org): Homepage covering WA education policy, SB 6346, and legislative updates.
- [About Our Bloggers](https://storiesfromschool.org/about): Profiles of educator contributors including Gretchen Cruden and Jan Kragen.
- [Stories From School | Page 2](https://storiesfromschool.org/page/2): Archive page of WA education policy posts including ESSB 5167, E2SSB 5263.
